name: User - Reset Trigger During Application
goal: Test that expressing intent to purchase a new car mid-flow resets all variables and restarts from Step 1.
constraints: User starts application, then types 'I want to purchase a new car' at Step 5.7.

phases.description: User progresses to Step 5.7, then re-expresses intent.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot resets all variables and restarts at Step 1.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
